paper_bid_sheet.title: Open Bid Sign-Up Sheet
paper_bid_sheet.intro: Drivers interested in this route should initial next to their name. Sign-up closes after two (2) school days — due {{bid_response_due_date}}. Failing to initial by that deadline is a rejection of the open position per Art. 3.08(c)(1).
paper_bid_sheet.footer: Names in bold have more seniority than the current route holder. Initial in the box next to your name if you want to bid.
